reviews.comment: Dr. Dana is the best! I loved her class so much! Her lectures were always interesting, organized, and engaging. Her exams were easy if you study well for them (4 exams including the final, which is non cumulative). There were a couple of projects, but they were straightforward and graded easy. Don't take any other prof for this class!

Super approachable and responds to emails quickly. She lectures fast. She gives hints at what might be on the exam. You can skip lecture and just look at the slides and still get an A on the exam but you may miss participation points. She also sneaks in some extra credit here and there. Projects are graded fairly. Definitely recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: She is one of the best profs I've ever had. Class consists of easy in class participations, quizzes, exams (final isn't cumulative), and two easy projects. You will miss out on points and extra credit if you don't go to class, but her lectures aren't boring so she makes actually showing up worth it. Take her if you can!!

Hands down, Dr. Dana is one of the best professors I have ever had! Her lectures are very interesting, and she always lets you know what to highlight/star in the slides. She includes study guides with each chapter, and her exams are very straightforward. 100% take her if you can!

She is a very nice professor who loves to learn about her students. If you go to class and write down what she is saying you will do great on the tests. She tells you when to star things that will be tested. Her class consists of exams (but no final), quizzes, easy in-class assignments that take 5 minutes, and a 3-part easy project.
